written.headline: OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO
written.summary: OpenAI is negotiating a private funding round of up to $30 billion that would value the company at $1.25 trillion pre‑money, led by Coatue and investors from the United Arab Emirates. The raise follows a March round that valued the firm at $852 billion and could set a new record for private‑company valuation.

written.headline: ThinkingBox training boosts Qwen3.8-27B agent success on database tasks
written.summary: Microsoft and Hugging Face released ThinkingBox-Training, fine‑tuning Qwen3.8-27B with 50 GRPO steps. The average pass@1 rose from 51.70% to 60.78% and pass@20 tasks solved increased from 38 to 107.

written.headline: Meta’s new commercial terms could let it scrape news sites for AI training
written.summary: Meta’s updated commercial terms, effective Oct. 30, 2026, allow business accounts to authorize the company to scrape content from associated websites, including news sites. Legal experts say the language still permits using that content to develop and train AI products.
